scope: Local-only diagnostic scans and isolated Windows UI checks; no production malware-clearance verdict
overallAcceptance: incomplete: production launcher detection remains unresolved

defender.scanMode: Custom diagnostic scan; includes archive contents, ignores exclusions, applies no scan remediation; real-time protection remains active

uiCheck.method: Computer Use Windows input injection and screenshots; loopback HTTP server requests and native fixture state provide supporting observations
uiCheck.otherRequests: Two favicon requests; no additional document requests after the UI changes
observations: Enter loaded /enter-after; the rendered heading/path and server request agreed
Go loaded /go-after without replacing the typed address; rendered content and server request agreed
Ctrl+L selected the address field; Ctrl+F opened Find; Enter highlighted the fixture sentence; Escape closed Find
Ctrl+T opened a second human-owned blank tab
A non-page sidebar drag ending over the background tab produced subtle gray feedback while keeping the blank tab selected
Workspace collapse used a right chevron; expansion used a down chevron and kept both tab hosts
Mouse selection displayed the connected selected tab and no dashed focus box
Sidebar resizing from 240 to 290 logical pixels retained synthetic form text and the current document
Captured selected-page frame corners were intact after resizing
Controls Workspaces showed the tab-table headers and gray selections without dashed focus boxes
Closing Controls preserved the selected page and synthetic form text
Native browser exit completed; saved settings retained Dark mode and sidebar width 290

limits: No-threat scan results and resource/code provenance do not establish malware clearance or the cause of the production detection
AuthTest is compile-time gated fixture software and cannot ship or substitute for production browsing
Windows UI input injection is not physical mouse/keyboard-device coverage
Still captures do not prove continuous divider hover or dragging is flicker-free
Background-tab feedback was observed during a non-page drag; ordinary hover-only pause rules were not tested in this run
No new Light/System, high-contrast, multiple-DPI/monitor, ownership/handoff, full menu/dialog or arbitrary website acceptance coverage
The earlier failed production branding record remains historical and unchanged
